brandSummary: F-DGSi is a French manufacturer of gas and liquid generators for laboratories and industry, making hydrogen, nitrogen, zero air and liquid nitrogen on site so users no longer depend on cylinders. Its COSMOS, CALYPSO, NESO and CRYOGEN ranges are matched to GC, GC-MS, LC-MS, ICP and cryogenic applications. Subsidiaries operate in India and the United States, and the products carry a Made in France label.

products.name: COSMOS MF.H2 Hydrogen Generator
products.summary: High-purity PEM hydrogen generator for GC carrier gas and detector fuel gas, delivering up to 1500 cc/min at better than 99.99999% purity and up to 11 bar. A cold dual regeneration dryer removes desiccant changes, and a touchscreen, leak checks and under 50 ml internal volume support safe bench use.
products.description: The COSMOS MF.H2 produces hydrogen from deionized water in a 100% titanium proton exchange membrane (PEM) cell, replacing cylinders for gas chromatographs that use hydrogen as carrier gas or as FID, FPD, NPD and TCD fuel. A cold dual dynamic regeneration dryer removes moisture and oxygen without desiccant cartridges and keeps purity stable around the clock. Eleven models cover 110 to 1500 cc/min, delivery pressure reaches 11 bar for fast and high-speed GC methods, and an optional cold palladium catalyst reduces oxygen below 0.01 ppm and moisture below 1 ppm. The unit checks for internal leaks at every start, monitors operating parameters continuously and holds less than 50 ml of hydrogen, so it can be used where cylinders are restricted. A touchscreen shows outlet pressure, flow, water quality and level and diagnostics, while USB links to a PC for remote monitoring. Units can be cascaded for higher flow. According to the manufacturer, switching from helium to hydrogen carrier gas saves 25 to 35% of run time with no loss of resolution. Laboratories in petrochemical, environmental, food and pharmaceutical testing use it for GC, GC-MS, hydrogenation and ICP-MS support.

products.description: The COSMOS MB.H2 is the standard-purity member of the COSMOS hydrogen range, aimed at gas chromatograph detectors that burn hydrogen, such as FID, FPD, NPD and TCD. It electrolyzes deionized water in a 100% titanium multilayer PEM cell and dries the gas with a static membrane dryer that needs no maintenance, giving purity above 99.9996% with oxygen under 1 ppm. Seven models deliver 110, 170, 260, 300, 400, 500 or 600 cc/min, with outlet pressure up to 11 bar. The generator tests itself for internal leaks at each start and constantly watches its operating parameters, and its internal gas volume is under 50 ml, which allows use where cylinders are risky or prohibited. A touchscreen shows pressure, flow, water quality and level with alarms and diagnostics, LEDs report status, and USB supports remote monitoring from a PC. The compact, stackable casing is 27 x 44 x 38 cm. Several units can run in cascade for up to 6 L/min, with automatic flow compensation if one stops, which gives continuous supply for critical applications. Laboratories use the MB.H2 where detector fuel gas, rather than carrier gas, is the main need.

products.name: COSMOS ZA Zero Air Generator
products.summary: Zero air generator that turns compressed air from an oil-free compressor into hydrocarbon-free air for GC detectors, with total hydrocarbons and CO below 0.05 ppm. Six models deliver 1 to 30 L/min at up to 6.5 bar in a compact, stackable housing that replaces zero air cylinders.
products.description: Flame ionization and similar GC detectors need air with almost no hydrocarbons, because any methane or other organic background raises noise and degrades the baseline. The COSMOS ZA strips hydrocarbons from the incoming compressed air, bringing total hydrocarbons, including methane, and carbon monoxide below 0.05 ppm so the detector baseline stays stable and sensitivity improves. It needs an external clean, dry air supply, such as the COSMOS air compressor that stacks with it, with inlet dew point below minus 20 °C, hydrocarbons below 100 ppm, 4.5 to 10 bar and an inlet temperature of no more than 40 °C. Models deliver 1.0, 1.5, 3, 6, 15 or 30 L/min at a maximum outlet pressure of 6.5 bar. Warm-up takes 40 to 50 minutes. LEDs show ready, warm-up, stand-by and alarm states, and USB or RS232 provide remote monitoring and diagnostics. The housing measures 30 x 15 x 54 cm and is designed to stack with other COSMOS modules. According to the manufacturer the investment can pay back in under a year compared with buying cylinders. Typical uses are GC-FID, GC-FPD, GC-NPD, total hydrocarbon analyzers and gas sensing.

products.name: COSMOS ZA.TOTAL Zero Air Total Generator
products.summary: Zero air generator that removes hydrocarbons, CO, CO2, NOx and moisture from compressed air using a palladium catalyst, dual molecular sieve PSA, Purafil and charcoal stages. Six models deliver 1 to 30 L/min with a dew point below minus 75 °C for demanding GC and gas-sensing work.
products.description: Where a detector or analyzer is sensitive to more than hydrocarbons, the COSMOS ZA.TOTAL purifies compressed air in several stages. A heated catalytic oven filled with palladium converts hydrocarbons, including methane, and carbon monoxide; a dual molecular sieve pressure swing adsorption system removes humidity and CO2; Purafil removes nitrogen oxide; and an active charcoal filter takes out remaining components. Hydrocarbons and CO fall below 0.05 ppm, NOx and SO2 below 0.05 ppm, and the outlet dew point is below minus 75 °C. The page quotes CO2 as under 5 ppm in its feature list but under 0.05 ppm in the specification table, so the precise figure should be confirmed with the manufacturer. The unit needs a clean, dry external air supply, which the COSMOS air compressor provides, and delivers 1.0 to 30 L/min at up to 6.5 bar depending on model. The stackable housing is 30 x 15 x 54 cm, LEDs show status, and USB or RS232 allow remote diagnostics. Typical uses include GC-FID, GC-FPD and GC-NPD detector air, total hydrocarbon analyzers and gas sensing in laboratories that previously used cylinders.

products.name: DEIMOS UZA Ultra Zero Air Generator
products.summary: Floor-standing ultra zero air generator with an integrated oil-free compressor, using PSA drying and a heated catalyst to bring total hydrocarbons and CO below 0.05 ppm. products.description: The DEIMOS UZA is built for laboratories that want an ultra-clean air supply without relying on a house compressed air line. It combines pressure swing adsorption to remove water vapor with a heated catalyst that oxidizes hydrocarbons, so total hydrocarbons and CO in the outlet are under 0.05 ppm. An integral oil-free compressor feeds the system and uses Energy Saving Technology to switch off when no air is drawn, which lowers energy use and extends compressor life. Seven models are offered, from 1 to 50 L/min, with a maximum outlet pressure of 6 bar and a particle filter rating of 0.01 micron. The outlet dew point is minus 50 or minus 65 °C depending on model. A color touchscreen shows inlet and outlet pressure, air flow and status, an audible alarm and maintenance log help service planning, and USB provides remote diagnostics. The cabinet is soundproofed, rolls on wheels and measures 47.5 x 66.2 cm (W x H) with a depth of 65 or 79 cm depending on model. Operating temperature is 5 to 25 °C, which should be considered for hot sites. It serves GC-FID, GC-FPD and GC-NPD detectors and CO2 analyzers.

products.name: COSMOS N2/ZN2 Nitrogen Generator
products.summary: PSA nitrogen generator for GC carrier gas, make-up gas, headspace pressurization, purge and trap and tube conditioning, with purity up to 99.9995%. The ZN2 versions add a catalyst module for hydrocarbons below 0.05 ppm, and the stackable bench unit pairs with COSMOS hydrogen, zero air and compressor modules.
products.description: The COSMOS N2 / ZN2 supplies nitrogen to gas chromatography and thermal analysis instruments without cylinders. Pressure swing adsorption over a carbon molecular sieve removes oxygen and moisture from compressed air, and the fully regenerative design carries a low contamination risk and is phthalate free. The N2 versions deliver 0.4, 0.8 or 1.0 L/min at under 5 ppm oxygen (above 99.9995% purity) and 0.8, 1.6 or 1.8 L/min at 100 ppm, while the ZN2 versions add a catalyst module that holds hydrocarbons below 0.05 ppm, measured as methane. Outlet pressure is 5.5 bar, outlet dew point is below minus 60 °C, particles are filtered to 0.01 micron and the unit reaches rated purity in about one hour from start-up. It needs inlet air at 6 to 8 bar to ISO 8573-1:2010 class 1.4.1, which the COSMOS air compressor can provide when stacked beneath it. LEDs report status, USB or RS232 allow remote diagnostics, and noise is below 25 dB. The unit measures 27 x 47 x 38 cm. Applications listed include GC-ECD, GC-MS, GC-AED, DSC, TGA, TOC and sample preparation, serving petrochemical, environmental and pharmaceutical laboratories.

products.name: NESO Nitrogen Generator
products.summary: Floor-standing PSA nitrogen generator delivering 1, 3 or 5 L/min at 99.9995% purity for GC, ICP, TOC, DSC and TGA instruments. It is offered with or without an integral oil-free compressor, with a color touchscreen, Energy Saving Technology and an optional oxygen sensor for online purity monitoring.
products.description: The NESO is a higher-capacity nitrogen source for laboratories that run several instruments from one supply. It uses fully regenerative pressure swing adsorption to separate nitrogen from air and delivers 99.9995% nitrogen, with oxygen under 5 ppm, at 1, 3 or 5 L/min and up to 6 bar. Each size is available without a compressor, in which case it needs clean inlet air at up to 8 bar to ISO 8573-1:2010 class 1.4.1 and 12, 36 or 60 L/min of flow, or with an integral oil-free compressor that makes the generator independent of the building air line. In compressor versions Energy Saving Technology stops the compressor when nitrogen is not drawn, and a sound-insulated box reduces noise. A color touchscreen displays process status, inlet and outlet pressure and flow, an audible alarm and visual maintenance log support servicing, and USB allows remote diagnostics. An optional oxygen sensor monitors nitrogen purity online, and the unit reaches rated purity in under 60 minutes. Operating temperature is 5 to 25 °C and altitude is limited to 3000 meters. The cabinet is on wheels and weighs 54 to 118 kg depending on version. Typical uses are GC, ICP, TOC, DSC and TGA.

products.name: CELENO Nitrogen Generator
products.summary: Nitrogen generator delivering 20 L/min with a dew point below minus 60 °C, designed for comprehensive two-dimensional GC (GCxGC) systems that use a cryogenic modulator. products.description: Comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography with a cryogenic modulator uses cooled nitrogen gas, and moisture in the supply can freeze and block cold lines. The CELENO supplies 20 L/min of nitrogen at 6 bar with a dew point below minus 60 °C so it can run cryogenic applications without icing. Purity is above 99.5% (under 0.5% oxygen), certified on oxygen content, and falls to a minimum of 97% at maximum flow. It uses fully regenerative pressure swing adsorption and is available without a compressor, needing 70 L/min of clean inlet air at up to 8 bar to ISO 8573-1:2010 class 1.4.1, or with an integral oil-free compressor using Energy Saving Technology. A color touchscreen reports process data, an audible alarm and maintenance history help servicing, and USB supports remote diagnostics. The unit reaches rated purity within 60 minutes, operates between 5 and 25 °C and measures 47.5 x 66.2 x 79 cm, weighing 91 kg without compressor and 118 kg with it. It is aimed at laboratories running GCxGC systems with a cryogenic modulator.

products.name: CALYPSO Nitrogen Generator
products.summary: PSA nitrogen generator range for LC-MS and sample evaporation, with five models from 15 to 70 L/min at up to 8 bar and purity of 99% to 99.99%. Available with or without an integrated oil-free compressor that switches off when idle, a color touchscreen and remote diagnostics.
products.description: LC-MS instruments consume large volumes of nitrogen for nebulizing, drying and sheath gas, and the CALYPSO range is built to supply them from compressed air rather than liquid nitrogen or cylinders. Five models, CALYPSO.15, .25, .35, .64 and .70, deliver 15 to 70 L/min at a maximum pressure of 8 bar (116 psi). A smart triple filtration stage and fully regenerative PSA technology give analytical grade nitrogen from 99% up to 99.99% purity, with the rating certified on oxygen content and a minimum of 99% at maximum flow. Most sizes are offered without a compressor, needing clean inlet air at 9 bar to ISO 8573-1:2010 class 1.4.1, or with an integrated oil-free compressor that uses Energy Saving Technology to stop when gas is not drawn. A color touchscreen shows pressure, nitrogen flow and system status, remote PC monitoring uses USB, and the unit is phthalate and BHT free. The compressor box is soundproofed, the chassis is on wheels and operating conditions are 5 to 35 °C with altitude up to 3000 m. Pharmaceutical, biotech, food safety and research laboratories running LC-MS or evaporators use the range. Instrument-specific variants such as CALYPSO DP and 2G models are also available.

products.name: TORNADO Industrial Nitrogen Generator
products.summary: Modular PSA nitrogen generator range for industrial and laboratory use, producing from under 1 to over 200 Nm3/h at residual oxygen from 10 ppm to 5%. An HMI touchscreen with oxygen sensor and inlet dew point alarms, standby economy mode and a design temperature range up to 50 °C support continuous duty.
products.description: The TORNADO range supplies nitrogen from an existing compressed air line to processes that consume more than a laboratory generator can deliver. Models from 1110 to 12130 produce between 0.9 and 27.2 Nm3/h at 99.999% purity and up to about 200 Nm3/h at 95%, with the exact flow set by the oxygen residual chosen between 10 ppm and 5%. Fully regenerative PSA keeps the gas phthalate free. An HMI touchscreen displays process variables, an oxygen sensor with alarm, and the inlet air dew point with alarm, and an IP address gives remote access. An automatic economy mode drops the unit into standby when no nitrogen is needed. Service is from the front only, and units can be banked in master and slave arrangements as demand grows. Design operating pressure is 6 to 12 barg, design operating temperature is 5 to 50 °C with 5 to 25 °C recommended, inlet particulates must be below 0.1 micron, inlet oil content 0.01 ppm and the recommended inlet dew point is minus 40 °C. Supply is 100 to 240 VAC at 72 W. Listed uses include oil and gas, ICP, LC-MS, NMR, food packaging, laser cutting and wine making.

products.name: CRYOGEN.40 Liquid Nitrogen Generator
products.summary: Water-cooled generator that makes liquid nitrogen on site from compressed air, producing up to 40 liters per day into a 210 liter dewar at over 99% purity. A cryo-refrigerator cold head and PSA nitrogen source run automatically, and the system is rated for ambient temperatures up to 52 °C with cooling water or a chiller.
products.description: The CRYOGEN.40 liquefies nitrogen on the premises, removing the cost, delivery logistics and handling hazards of buying liquid nitrogen. Nitrogen gas from a PSA unit with an oil-free air compressor is cooled to 77 K (minus 196 °C) by a cold head driven by a helium compressor in a cryo-refrigerator design. Output is up to 40 liters per day, or 1.67 liters per hour, at a purity above 99% with oxygen under 1%, collected in a 210 liter dewar at 1.5 bar, with higher pressures to 4 bar available on request. A color HMI touchscreen shows dewar level and PSA production and runs the system automatically with remote diagnostics, while a built-in oxygen analyzer with alarm, a vacuum prevention system, a zero-loss evaporation mode and a pressure boost function are included. Liquid is drawn off through a 1.5 m vacuum-jacketed hose. The helium compressor is water cooled and needs a chiller or cooling water, which the manufacturer says allows operation up to 52 °C ambient. Power draw is 4.2 kW excluding the chiller. Typical users are research laboratories, cryopreservation and IVF units, dermatology clinics, metal treatment and animal husbandry.
